Similarly, compute HCF(36,48)=12. Then compute HCF(12, HCF(72,96)). HCF(72,96)=24. Then HCF(12,24)=12.

Thus results: For first set: HCF(45,60)=15; HCF(90,120)=30; HCF(15,30)=15. For second set: HCF(36,48)=12; HCF(72,96)=24; HCF(12,24)=12.

We can also call tool for combined pairs: (15,30) and (12,24). But the tool only accepts two numbers. We can call for those too. So total calls: 6.
